description: This file defines the SocialMediaAuthenticationController class within the OrangeHRM OpenID Authentication plugin, responsible for managing social media authentication processes. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up an authentication provider list component during the pre-render phase.

classes.name: SocialMediaAuthenticationController
classes.description: Controller class for handling social media authentication integration, extending the AbstractVueController to leverage Vue.js components.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the 'auth-provider-list' component before rendering the view, injecting necessary UI elements for social media authentication.
